p03-team.observed_description: Nine smiling players in identical plain yellow shirts and blue shorts pose for a team photo on a grass field, four standing behind and five kneeling in front with their arms around each other, a ball on the grass in front.
p03-team.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). There are nine players, not the eight asked for; it is still plainly one team. The shirts are plain.

p04-game.observed_description: A football match on a grass field seen from the side line: a player in a plain red shirt kicks the ball among players in plain blue shirts, with a goal and a few spectators behind.
p04-game.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

p05-tennis.observed_description: Two adults in white play tennis on a clay court, seen from behind the near player, a woman swinging her racket at the yellow ball; a man waits with his racket across the net. Two people.
p05-tennis.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

p06-sing.observed_description: Ana (long wavy black hair, olive-green shirt over a white top) sings into a microphone she holds on its stand, mouth wide open, eyes closed, her other hand raised, in a plain room. One person.
p06-sing.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

p09-they-sing.observed_description: Two women and a man stand side by side in a plain bright room and sing together with their mouths wide open, each holding an open plain folder. Three people; no instruments.
